lines.text: The LORD has Moses collect twelve staffs, one per tribe leader, with the name Aaron on the Levi staff.
Moses places the staffs in front of the golden calf, and the chosen man's staff will sprout.

wrong_details.wrong: in front of the golden calf
wrong_details.true: in the Tent of Meeting in front of the Testimony

lines.text: Moses lays twelve staffs before the LORD, and the next day the staff of Levi has buds, blossoms, and almonds.
Moses puts the staff of Aaron back as a sign, so the people will not be enslaved.

wrong_details.wrong: so the people will not be enslaved

lines.text: The Israelites cry out that they are perishing and that anyone who comes near the tabernacle will die.
